overview.description: The iShares iBonds Oct 2035 Term TIPS ETF (IBIL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks a market value-weighted index of US Treasury inflation-protected securities maturing between January and October 2035. The fund will terminate in October 2035 IBIL was launched on Mar 25, 2025 and is issued by BlackRock.
